name: OpenClaw Lobster Monitor
description: Read-only monitor exporter for the public lobster dashboard.

serverUrl.label: Dashboard URL
serverUrl.help: Public dashboard base URL. The plugin posts snapshots to /api/ingest.

ingestToken.label: Ingest Token
ingestToken.help: Shared secret used by the public monitor server.

pollIntervalMs.label: CLI Reconcile Interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.help: Low-frequency background reconciliation interval for OpenClaw CLI. Realtime status updates come from event hooks.

eventDebounceMs.label: Event Debounce (ms)
eventDebounceMs.help: Small debounce window used to coalesce bursts of status events before uploading.

cliTimeoutMs.label: CLI Timeout (ms)
cliTimeoutMs.help: Upper bound for each OpenClaw CLI probe. Slow commands are skipped to keep the dashboard responsive.

enableCli.label: Use OpenClaw CLI
enableCli.help: When disabled, the plugin reports config-derived agent info only.

tags.label: Tags
tags.help: Optional tags for grouping this source in the monitor.
